stdout_tail:
Unrecognized option: 1

Usage:
  nx_test [-p prog_list [-t test_list]][-m path_to_executable] [-d dir] [--make_env]

Options:
  -h, --help      Print this help.
  -p, --prog      Comma-separated list of interfaces for which
                   to run the tests.  If left empty, all interfaces
                   present in $NXHOME/examples/ will be tested.
  -t, --tests     List of tests to run for each interface. The
                   tests must be comma-separated, and the tests
                   for different programs are sperated by '|'.
                   For instance, to run the test 1 for columbus
                   interface and 1 and 2 for turbomole interface,
                   the following line commands must be used:
                   -p turbomole,columbus -t "01|01,02".
                   This option can be used ONLY WHEN a list
                   of programs is specified.
  -m, --mdexe     Full path to the program used for running
                   trajectories.
                   Default: $NXHOME/bin/md
  -d, --dir       Directory where the tests will be run.
                   Default: "./tests/"
  --make_env      Indicate if the this program is run via
                   "make check".

--------------- Examples ---------------

  1) Run all tests:

       nx_test

  2) Run all tests for interface COLUMBUS only:

       nx_test -p columbus

  3) Run tests 01, 02 and 03 for interface COLUMBUS:

       nx_test -p columbus -t "1,2,3"

  4) Run tests 01, 02 and 03 for interface COLUMBUS, and
     01 and 04 for TURBOMOLE:

       nx_test -p columbus,turbomole -t "1,2,3|1,4"
